display.purpose: Reserved for future marketing-grade pages outside the product surface. No current consumer.

title.purpose: section.heading and cta-bar.heading. Group identity within a page.

body.purpose: All prose, task titles, setting labels. Max 60ch line length.

label.purpose: Eyebrow on page-header (uppercase, tracking 0.08em, opacity 0.55), task-item due (mono), task-item note.

shadows.name: toggle-knob-depth
shadows.purpose: Component-level only. Lifts the toggle knob off its track so movement reads physically. The only shadow in the system.

motion.name: ease-state
motion.purpose: All state transitions (toggle slide, button hover, input focus ring). 120ms duration.

breakpoints.name: setting-row-stack
breakpoints.purpose: Container query: setting-row collapses from two-column to single-column stack below this width.

breakpoints.name: cta-bar-row
breakpoints.purpose: Container query: cta-bar switches from stacked to two-column row (heading+body left, action right) at or above this width.

breakpoints.name: storyboard-frame
breakpoints.purpose: Storyboard frame width. Every screen renders at this width inside dist/storyboard.html so authors verify design at canonical desktop viewport.

components.name: Action Primary Button
components.description: Page-level primary call. Used once per screen at most.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; border: 1px solid oklch(52% 0.16 250); background: oklch(52% 0.16 250); color: oklch(99% 0.003 250); font: inherit; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 120ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:active { filter: brightness(0.92); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(70% 0.18 60); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Action Secondary Button
components.description: Non-decisive actions: Change email, Export as text, Restore to today.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; border: 1px solid oklch(92% 0.005 250); background: transparent; color: oklch(18% 0.01 250); font: inherit; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 120ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(70% 0.18 60); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Action Ghost Button
components.description: Tertiary calls: Change to Sunday, Delete permanently (note: destructive currently borrows ghost; gap 8).
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0; border: 1px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: oklch(18% 0.01 250); font: inherit; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 0.05em; text-underline-offset: 0.2em; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 120ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); }

components.name: Toggle (off)
components.description: Default off state. Used in setting-row.control for boolean preferences.
components.css: .ds-toggle { position: relative; display: inline-block; width: 2.5rem; height: 1.35rem; padding: 0; border: 1px solid oklch(92% 0.005 250); border-radius: 999px; background: oklch(96% 0.005 250); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out, border-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-toggle::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0.15rem; left: 0.15rem; width: 1.05rem; height: 1.05rem; border-radius: 999px; background: oklch(99% 0.003 250); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.18); transition: transform 120ms ease-out; } .ds-toggle[aria-pressed="true"] { background: oklch(52% 0.16 250); border-color: oklch(52% 0.16 250); } .ds-toggle[aria-pressed="true"]::before { transform: translateX(1.05rem); } .ds-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(70% 0.18 60); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Inline data-entry. Placeholder visible, focus ring amber.
components.html: <input type="search" class="ds-text-input" placeholder="Search tasks…" aria-label="Search tasks">
components.css: .ds-text-input { display: inline-block; box-sizing: border-box; min-width: 16rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border: 1px solid oklch(92% 0.005 250); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: oklch(99% 0.003 250); color: oklch(18% 0.01 250); font: inherit; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.55; transition: border-color 120ms ease-out, box-shadow 120ms ease-out; } .ds-text-input::placeholder { color: oklch(18% 0.01 250); opacity: 0.45; } .ds-text-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: oklch(70% 0.18 60); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(70% 0.18 60 / 0.18); }

components.name: Task Item (pending)
components.description: Single task row. Custom checkbox on the left, title dominant, due-time mono right-aligned, optional note below.
components.html:
Draft Q2 strategy memo

11:00

Three sections done; intro and conclusion remain.
components.css: .ds-task-item { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto; grid-template-rows: auto auto; column-gap: 1rem; row-gap: 0.25rem; align-items: baseline; padding: 1rem 1.5rem; border-top: 1px solid oklch(92% 0.005 250); background: oklch(99% 0.003 250); color: oklch(18% 0.01 250); } .ds-task-checkbox { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; width: 1.1rem; height: 1.1rem; padding: 0; border: 1.5px solid oklch(92% 0.005 250); border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; align-self: center; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out, border-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-task-checkbox:hover { border-color: oklch(18% 0.01 250); } .ds-task-checkbox:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(70% 0.18 60); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-task-title { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; font: inherit; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.55; font-weight: 500; margin: 0; min-width: 0; } .ds-task-due { grid-column: 3; grid-row: 1; font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.8125rem; line-height: 1.45; opacity: 0.6; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-task-note { grid-column: 2 / -1; grid-row: 2; font-size: 0.8125rem; line-height: 1.45; opacity: 0.6; margin: 0; }

components.name: Setting Row
components.description: Labelled row with a control on the right. Container query collapses to single-column stack below 500px.
components.html:
Show completed tasks

When on, finished tasks remain visible until midnight.
components.css: .ds-setting-row { container-type: inline-size; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; row-gap: 0.5rem; padding: 1rem 1.5rem; border-top: 1px solid oklch(92% 0.005 250); background: oklch(99% 0.003 250); color: oklch(18% 0.01 250); } @container (min-width: 500px) { .ds-setting-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; column-gap: 2.5rem; align-items: center; row-gap: 0; } } .ds-setting-label-group { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.25rem; } .ds-setting-label { font-size: 1.125rem; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 500; margin: 0; } .ds-setting-description { font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.55; max-width: 60ch; opacity: 0.8; margin: 0; } .ds-setting-control { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; }

components.name: Page Header
components.description: App-chrome header. Eyebrow + title + meta + optional action. Replaces hero-text for product screens.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-page-header { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; grid-template-rows: auto auto auto; column-gap: 1.5rem; row-gap: 0.25rem; padding: 2.5rem 2.5rem 1.5rem; border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(92% 0.005 250); background: oklch(94% 0.005 250); color: oklch(18% 0.01 250); align-items: baseline; } .ds-eyebrow { grid-column: 1 / -1; grid-row: 1; font-size: 0.8125rem; line-height: 1.45; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; font-weight: 500; opacity: 0.55; margin: 0; } .ds-page-title { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 2; font-size: 2.25rem; line-height: 1.15; font-weight: 700; margin: 0; } .ds-page-meta { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 3; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.55; opacity: 0.7; margin: 0; } .ds-page-action { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 2; align-self: center; justify-self: end; }

components.name: CTA Bar (emphasis)
components.description: Page-level callout. Used quietly in footers; emphasis tone inverts to Deep Indigo for the one trial-expiry banner per session.
components.html:
Trial ends in 18 days

Twelve dollars a year after that. One charge, no renewals you forget about.
components.css: .ds-cta-bar { container-type: inline-size; display: block; padding: 1.5rem 2.5rem; border-radius: 0.75rem; background: oklch(23% 0.04 250); color: oklch(99% 0.003 250); } @container (min-width: 600px) { .ds-cta-bar { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; align-items: center; column-gap: 2.5rem; row-gap: 0.25rem; } .ds-cta-bar .ds-cta-heading { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; } .ds-cta-bar .ds-cta-body { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 2; } .ds-cta-bar .ds-cta-action { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1 / span 2; align-self: center; } } .ds-cta-heading { font-size: 1.625rem; line-height: 1.25; font-weight: 600; margin: 0; } .ds-cta-body { font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.55; max-width: 56ch; opacity: 0.85; margin: 0; }

narrative.overview: focus is paper, ink, and one quiet accent. The interface is a single sheet rendered at desk-sized width, holding a finite list and nothing else. The visual register sits at the corner of editorial-minimal and Apple-craft (Things.app rather than Linear): generous spacing, soft borders, custom toggles tuned to feel like fountain-pen marks rather than checkbox glyphs. No motion that decorates, no shadows that perform depth, no colour that competes for attention.
keyCharacteristics: Paper-cool background with near-black ink. Single accent kept rare.
Flat surfaces with tonal layering for depth — no shadows.
Type scale fluid via clamp() from 320px to 1200px viewport.
Container queries everywhere; components adapt to their parent width, not the device viewport.
Custom-built toggle and checkbox primitives, not native controls.
Border-based dividers between row items, not shadowed cards.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Accent Blue carries no more than 10% of any given screen by area. Two toggles on, one primary button is the upper limit. If accent shows up four times on one page, drop one.

rules.name: The No Black Rule
rules.body: No #000, no #fff. Every neutral is tinted toward the brand hue (chroma ≥ 0.003) so that the paper and ink read as one family rather than as two raw extremes.

rules.name: The Fluid Scale Rule
rules.body: Every typographic step is clamp() against viewport width (320–1200px). No fixed-pixel font sizes.

rules.name: The Eyebrow Whisper Rule
rules.body: When eyebrow text appears above a headline, it sits at Label size, all caps, tracking 0.08em, opacity 0.55. Never larger, never bolder.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never lift. No box-shadow on cards or sections. If a block needs depth, it is the wrong block or the wrong tone.

rules.name: The Border-First Divider Rule
rules.body: Row dividers are always 1px solid borders in rule-subtle, never shadows. First-child rows lose the top border.

dos: Do keep Accent Blue at ≤10% of any screen by area.
Do use OKLCH for every colour value; never hex, never named CSS colours.
Do use container queries for responsive behaviour, not viewport media queries.
Do express depth through tonal layering (Page Canvas → Paper Warm → Paper) and 1px borders, not shadows.
Do use mono font for due times and data identifiers. Body sans for prose.
Do preserve :first-child border removal on row stacks.
Do gate every transition with prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
donts: Don't use #000 or #fff. Every neutral is tinted toward hue 250.
Don't use border-left or border-right >1px as a coloured accent stripe. Use box-shadow inset instead.
Don't add box-shadow for elevation at the block or section level.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text on a gradient background).
Don't introduce productivity-influencer aesthetics — neon accents, ALL-CAPS hype copy, dark-mode-only intensity themes.
Don't add streaks, points, badges, completion graphs, weekly charts.
Don't reach for a modal as the first thought for any flow.
Don't use intent=ghost for destructive actions once destructive intent lands.
Don't introduce native input type=checkbox; the custom checkbox is part of the craft signature.
